To test our framework, we have considered 50, 100, 150, and 200 peers connected to 
the network and uploaded data of 20MB, 40MB, 60MB, 80MB, 100MB, 120MB, and 
140MB. Figure 8. depicts the IPFS network upload time analysis. The experimental result 
shows that the upload time increased with both the number of peers and the size of the 
file being uploaded, but that at a certain point, the upload time varies very little even 
when the number of peers and the size of the file both vary. Once a certain threshold is 
achieved, every further increase in the file size for uploading results in a small increase 
in uploading time. IPFS download time analysis is shown in Fig.  9. The result shows that 
the download time increased with both the file size and the number of peers. The time 
required to download the file significantly decreased when we increased its size while 
keeping the number of peers constant. The experimental results show that uploading 
files to the IPFS network takes longer than downloading. Download and Upload times 
were measured with a number of peer counts and file sizes for experimental evaluation, 
as shown in Table 4. Figure 10. analyzes the upload and download times between Block -
chain and IPFS. Based on experimental evaluation and analysis, it has been observed 
that the IPFS network has much faster upload and download speeds than the Blockchain 
network.

resposta.resumo: O estudo compara desempenho de upload, download e acesso de arquivos entre IPFS e blockchain em um cenário de saúde inteligente, mostrando que IPFS oferece velocidades significativamente maiores, embora o tempo de mineração seja maior no blockchain.

evidencias.afirmacao: O tempo de upload aumenta com o número de pares e o tamanho do arquivo, mas estabiliza após certo ponto.
evidencias.citacao: upload time increased with both the number of peers and the size of the file being uploaded, but that at a certain point, the upload time varies very little

evidencias.afirmacao: IPFS apresenta velocidades de upload e download muito superiores às da rede blockchain.
evidencias.citacao: IPFS network has much faster upload and download speeds than the Blockchain network

resposta.interpretacao: Os resultados indicam que, para compartilhamento de dados de saúde em cidades inteligentes, utilizar IPFS pode reduzir significativamente a latência de transferência, embora a camada de blockchain ainda seja necessária para garantir integridade e consenso, refletindo um trade‑off entre desempenho e segurança.
